name: Scale-Dependent Downweighting for Grid Interpolation
definition: A technique to anti-alias trilinear interpolation in neural radiance fields by downweighting features interpolated from grid cells that are small relative to the sampling Gaussian's spread, preventing aliasing artifacts from high-frequency content.
summary: Scale-Dependent Downweighting anti-aliases trilinear interpolation in neural radiance fields by weighting samples based on the Gaussian CDF relative to grid cell size.
